title: [Bug Fix] #620132: Prevent IRS 1099 data on vendor ledger entries of non-1099 vendors
summary: Added validation to prevent IRS 1099 data from being entered on vendor ledger entries for vendors not set up for 1099 reporting. The validation checks that a vendor has an IRS 1099 Vendor Form Box Setup record for the selected reporting period before allowing IRS 1099 fields to be populated.
key_points: Validates that vendors have 1099 setup before accepting 1099 reporting period, form number, or form box assignments
Added CheckVendorSubjectFor1099Reporting method to verify vendor-period setup exists
Prevents data inconsistency where non-1099 vendors could receive 1099 information
Includes three new test cases covering validation and clearing scenarios
